page_title: MCI 3-1 BUR | Manchester City v Burnley 31/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Sergio Gomez (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+3' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! David Datro Fofana is the provider as he slips the ball to Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 3:1.
90+2' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is flagged for offside.
90+1' 75:25 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Julian Alvarez did his best and is replaced by Sergio Gomez (Manchester City).
87' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) replaces Rodri.
86' Substitution. Hjalmar Ekdal will be replaced by Han-Noah Massengo (Burnley).
86' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.

85' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.

85' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) rises high to meet a cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and powers his header on goal, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes a save. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
82' Ederson makes a brilliant save! Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.
81' Burnley are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
81' Today's referee Samuel Barrott rightly decides to book Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) for his harsh tackle.
79' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) plays a lovely through ball to Matheus Nunes, but he can't beat James Trafford and loses the ball.
77' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Phil Foden and he is replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
76' Substitution. Anass Zaroury (Burnley) has come on for Wilson Odobert.
75' Ederson (Manchester City) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Samuel Barrott ignores the protests.
75' Vitinho (Burnley) sends a long ball in, but Ederson comfortably gathers the ball.
75' Connor Roberts (Burnley) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
73' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kevin De Bruyne will be replaced by Erling Haaland (Manchester City).
71' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.

70' Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
67' Some neat passing and movement from Manchester City as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
64' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

61' Vitinho (Burnley) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where David Datro Fofana was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
59' Substitution. Lyle Foster makes his way off the pitch and David Datro Fofana (Burnley) comes on as his replacement.
59' Here is a change. Zeki Amdouni is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Connor Roberts (Burnley).
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Johann Berg Gudmundsson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley).
56' Vitinho (Burnley) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Manchester City.
54' Phil Foden (Manchester City) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
54' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) works the corner short.
54' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

52' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
51' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but James Trafford is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
51' Phil Foden (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

49' Sander Berge (Burnley) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Samuel Barrott with no other option than to blow for a foul.
48' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' 3 - 0 Goal! Rodri (Manchester City) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' The foul by Sander Berge (Burnley) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
44' Lyle Foster (Burnley) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
43' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
41' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
39' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
38' It seemed like Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
38' It looks like Vitinho (Burnley) saw red with that tackle. Samuel Barrott won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Manchester City get a free kick.

35' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
35' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
32' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
31' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) meets a cross inside the box, but Ederson wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
30' One of the players from Burnley times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
29' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

28' What a wasted opportunity by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but James Trafford makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
27' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
26' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) attempts to release Lyle Foster with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
24' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
24' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Burnley win a corner kick.
22' 2 - 0 Kevin De Bruyne floats a lovely ball in from the free kick to Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), and he slots the ball into the bottom left corner to increase the score to 2:0.
21' Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Samuel Barrott didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
21' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but James Trafford comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
19' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Matheus Nunes and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
15' That's unlucky! Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
14' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

13' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
12' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
8' James Trafford comes off his line to intercept the corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).

8' The free kick is delivered by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Sander Berge (Burnley) was too aggressive in his challenge. Manchester City earn a free kick.
6' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and it's Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to James Trafford, who smothers the ball.
2' Vitinho (Burnley) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Samuel Barrott.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
